The *Iddhikammavipākapañha* ("Moggallāna and the Results of Deeds") is an inquiry preserved within the fifth chapter of the *Milindapañha* [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral lists three translations of the text in three languages, and notes a thematic or textual association with the *Paṭhamavagga* of the Aṅguttara Nikāya (AN 1.188–197) [SuttaCentral].
No curated parallels are cataloged for this inquiry, but automated text-reuse analysis by DharmaNexus records 132 matching passages across 20 other Pali compositions [DharmaNexus]. Across corpora, DharmaNexus notes minor text alignments with the Sanskrit *Sukhāvatīvyūha*, though these reflect automated phrasing overlaps rather than direct historical parallels [DharmaNexus].
